lines.text: Лежачи на животі. Ляжте на живіт, витягніть стегна і залиштеся так. 10 хвилин, 2 рази на день.
lines.source_en: Lying face down. Lie on your stomach with both hips straight and stay there. 10 minutes, 2 times a day.
lines.back_translation: Lying on the stomach. Lie on your stomach, extend the hips and remain like that. 10 minutes, 2 times a day.

lines.text: Місток на одній нозі (права). Ляжте на спину, зігніть праве коліно, а іншу ногу витягніть, підніміть стегна над ліжком. 3 × 10, щодня.
lines.source_en: Single-leg bridge (right). Lie on your back with your right knee bent and the other leg straight, and lift your hips off the bed. 3 × 10, every day.
lines.back_translation: Bridge on one leg (right). Lie on your back, bend your right knee, and extend the other leg, lift the hips above the bed. 3 × 10, every day.

lines.text: Підйом ноги на боці (ліва). Ляжте на бік і підніміть верхню ногу прямо вгору, потім повільно опустіть її. 3 × 12, щодня.
lines.source_en: Side-lying leg lift (left). Lie on your side and lift the upper leg straight up, then lower it slowly. 3 × 12, every day.
lines.back_translation: Leg raise on the side (left). Lie on your side and lift the upper leg straight up, then slowly lower it. 3 x 12, every day.

lines.text: Випрямлення коліна сидячи з еспандером (ліва). Сядьте на стілець, обмотайте еспандером навколо щиколотки і повільно випрямте коліно. 3 × 12, щодня.
lines.source_en: Seated knee straightening with a band (left). Sit on a chair with the band around the ankle and straighten the knee slowly. 3 × 12, every day.
lines.back_translation: Knee straightening while sitting with an expander (left). Sit on a chair, wrap the expander around the ankle, and slowly straighten the knee. 3 x 12, every day.

lines.text: Стійка на одній нозі (ліва). Станьте на одну ногу поруч зі стійкою, за яку можна вчепитися, і утримуйте положення. 3 × 30 секунд, щодня, вдома. Станьте поруч із кухонною стійкою. З ваших записів: Перевірте шкіру кульгавої кінцівки після носіння протеза.
lines.source_en: Single-leg stance (left). Stand on one leg next to a counter you can grab, and hold the position. 3 × 30 seconds, every day, at home. Stand next to the kitchen counter. From your records: Check the skin of the residual limb after wearing the prosthesis.
lines.back_translation: Standing on one leg (left). Stand on one leg next to a support that you can hold onto, and maintain the position. 3 x 30 seconds, every day, at home. Stand next to the kitchen counter. From your records: Check the skin of the affected limb after wearing the prosthesis.

objections.detail: R04: documented restriction found, therapist decides. Standing on the left prosthesis alone only in supervised sessions until the prosthetist clears it.

raised.detail: R04: documented restriction found, therapist decides. Standing on the left prosthesis alone only in supervised sessions until the prosthetist clears it.
The original specifies the left side, while the Ukrainian specifies the right side.
The Ukrainian uses 'гомілки' (lower leg), while the original uses 'ankle'. This is a slight difference in specificity, but could be interpreted differently.

The Ukrainian uses 'кульшової частини' (hip part) instead of 'residual limb'. The original includes a note about checking the skin after wearing the prosthesis, which is missing in the back-translation.
R04: documented restriction found, therapist decides. Standing on the left prosthesis alone only in supervised sessions until the prosthetist clears it.
The Ukrainian back-translation refers to 'hip joint' (кульшової частини) instead of 'residual limb' (the part that was removed).
